name: Lysergic acid 3-pentyl amide
summary: Lysergic acid 3-pentylamide (LSP), also known as N-(3-pentyl)lysergamide, is an analogue of LSD originally researched by David E. Nichols and colleagues at Purdue University. It has similar binding affinity to LSD itself as both a 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A agonist, and produces similar behavioral and physiological responses in animals with only slightly lower potency than LSD.

pharmacology.text: It has similar binding affinity to LSD itself as both a 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A agonist, and produces similar behavioral and physiological responses in animals with only slightly lower potency than LSD.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied in animals as an LSD analogue. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，曾在動物身上作為 LSD 類似物研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，曾在动物身上作为 LSD 类似物研究，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Psychedelic lysergamides such as LSD can cause anxiety, confusion, paranoia, nausea, a faster heart rate and dilated pupils, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻類麥角醯胺可能引起焦慮、混亂、偏執、噁心、心跳加快與瞳孔放大，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻类麦角酰胺可能引起焦虑、混乱、偏执、恶心、心跳加快与瞳孔放大，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: Its 3-pentyl group is symmetrical, so it is essentially LSD with one extra carbon slotted between the nitrogen and the two ethyl groups, which made it a neat probe of how LSD fits its receptor.
fact.zh: 它的3-戊基是對稱的，所以它基本上就是在 LSD 的氮原子與兩個乙基之間多插入一個碳，因此成為研究 LSD 如何嵌入受體的好工具。
fact.zhHans: 它的3-戊基是对称的，所以它基本上就是在 LSD 的氮原子与两个乙基之间多插入一个碳，因此成为研究 LSD 如何嵌入受体的好工具。
